answer: Audits are logged in plume, queued in karst, and nectar publishes the wait time. A farm of 133 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 83 identities per epoch. A farm of 4701 identities would post 4403 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
